To achieve that, a circular or at least semicircular sitting plan would be ideal. When we all sit towards the board it is usually hard to understand other people if they are sitting in front of us because of acoustics. I suggest this not solely for acoustic reasons, this type of sitting plan would make us feel more included and equal which would result in a more fertile discussion atmosphere.
